beats.say: That bat in your garden is *not* blind. It can see you.
But Rudi felt sorry for the poor, *blind* little bat.
So he made it tiny *glasses.* The bat caught a moth in the dark. Without them.
So Rudi got it a *guide dog.* The bat just flew circles around it.
Here's the thing: every bat species can *see.*
Their eyes are packed with night vision cells. Up to *five times* more than yours.
And in the dark, they *shout,* and listen for the echo.
Bat Conservation International puts it simply: bats are *not* blind.
A pipistrelle fits in a *matchbox,* and can eat three thousand insects in one night.
Want to help? Hang a *bat box,* and never touch a bat with bare hands.
So next time someone says blind as a bat, just remember...
